text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after a bout of heavy rain, I go
to check
in about the status of the track
with a staff
member I'm acquainted with,
when...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Might we have a moment of
your
time?

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, of course. We were just
finishing up our
conversation. I'll be off,
then!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait! We're actually hoping to speak with you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're in charge of taking care of the
training
track, yes? Would it be all right
if we asked you a
few questions?

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Sure. I'm guessing yesterday's rain has
you two
worried, huh?

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
It really poured out here, didn't it? But
you don't
have to worry. It's totally fine
to use it today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can see that, but that's why it's so
terribly
strange!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You see, yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't appear like the rain will stop. I
wonder
if it'll be dry enough to train on
by tomorrow
morning.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We'll just have to come check! At the
very least,
we'll be able to do stretches!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We didn't have our hopes up, so we
were
surprised how pristine and dry the
track was! It
was like yesterday's rain
never even happened!

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Well, it wasn't all dry this
morning, but I
finished up the job with
some elbow grease.
Gotta keep the
track ready for everyone, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you mean you dried it off
manually?! But
when?! It was already
completely dry early this
morning.

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's diligent athletes like you
who come
out at the crack of dawn to
practice. You
motivate me to work just
as hard.

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
That's why I always make sure to wrap
up my
morning routine before the
grounds open for the
day.

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I won't argue with that. But it's all
of you
who make my job worth doing.

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Running in the competition of your
dreams
against your rivals...

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
If waking up a little earlier than normal
means I
can help you all achieve your
goals, then I'm more
than happy to do
so.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um! Do you mind if I ask one more
question?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What made you decide to work at
Tracen
Academy instead of the
racecourses that hold
those competitions
we all dream of?

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text: Well, that's because...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer! Because of
you, I was
finally able to realize my
dream!

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that racer crying in joy at her
moment of
triumph moved me. It made
me wonder just how
hard she had to
work to reach her goal.

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
The more I thought of it, the more
restless I
became. I wanted to do all I
could to help racers
fulfill their dreams,
so I came here to Tracen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After seeing the staff member off, I
come back to
find the two students with
serious looks on their
faces.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I never considered how hard the staff
worked to
support us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I really feel I mustn't take their efforts
for
granted, especially after that
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If only we could do something to show
them our
appreciation...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just the maintenance staff
we have to
thank either, is it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right. There are also the cooks in the
cafeteria
who make us such delicious
meals every day.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And also the custodians who keep the
academy
nice and clean.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What if we did something for everyone
to show
them our thanks?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to start thinking of something
right
away!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've realized the extent to
which
everyone supports us, I want to
make sure I
express my gratitude to all
of them!
